name: AOPII
source:
Befriending the new kid at school usually isn't a problem... until they have more in common with you than meets the eye.

Nova is just trying to finish high school when a new kid joins her class- however, she later finds out that they have something big in common and slowly become friends.

[From [url=https://mikomigames.itch.io/aopii] itch.io[/url]]
